AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.

2. When learning Aircraft Tools and Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Tools and Materials.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

6. When learning Airport Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airport Safety.
